cards.text: God is still giving Moses, Israel's leader, words to pass on to the Israelites. He's already covered servants, oxen, lawsuits and feasts (Exodus 21:1-23:19). Now He looks down the road ahead, and He's sending someone out in front of them.

cards.question: Who does God say He's sending ahead of the Israelites?
God says the angel He's sending will bring the Israelites to the place He has prepared.

cards.text: Then God gives a heads-up about this angel: pay attention to him, listen to his voice, and do not defy him. You know when somebody ignores the directions because they "know a shortcut"? NOT this trip, friend.

cards.question: God says the Israelites must not defy the angel. What reason does He give?

answers.text: The angel will not forgive rebellion
The angel will turn back to Egypt
The angel will go to another people

cards.question: God says His Name is in the angel He's sending ahead of Israel.

cards.text: Now the flip side. If they listen carefully to the angel's voice and do everything God says, God makes them a promise.

cards.question: If the Israelites listen and obey, God says He will be ___ to their enemies.

cards.text: Then God names the land His angel will bring them into: the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites and Jebusites. And God says, "I will annihilate them."
Those nations come with their own gods. And God doesn't leave Israel guessing about what to do with them.

cards.question: God says Israel can follow the nations' practices, as long as they don't bow down to their gods.
Instead of serving the nations' gods, what does God tell Israel to do with them?

answers.text: Demolish them and smash their sacred stones
Leave them standing and stay away from them
Carry them off and keep them as plunder

cards.text: Instead of all that, they're to serve the LORD their God. And when they do, God says He will bless their bread and their water.

cards.question: When the Israelites serve the LORD, God says He will take away ___ from among them.

cards.text: God keeps going: no woman in their land will miscarry or be barren. And He says, "I will fulfill the number of your days."
God says He'll send His terror ahead of Israel. He'll throw into confusion every nation they meet.

cards.question: God says He'll make all of Israel's enemies do something. What is it?

cards.text: That's not the only thing God sends on ahead. The next one is a whole lot smaller.

cards.question: What does God send before Israel to drive the Hivites, Canaanites and Hittites out of the way?

cards.text: Friend, one hornet in my bakery and I'm out the door in a single SECOND. But God says He won't drive the nations out in a single year, or the land would become desolate and wild animals would multiply against Israel.

cards.question: God will drive the nations out little by little, until Israel becomes ___ and possesses the land.

cards.text: Then God says He'll set their borders: from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines, and from the desert to the Euphrates River. Friend, my whole territory used to be the back of a takeout menu in a junk drawer.

cards.question: God says He will deliver the land's inhabitants into Israel's hand.

cards.text: Now God gets to one last warning. It's about how Israel deals with these nations and their gods.

cards.question: Israel may make a covenant with these nations, as long as it doesn't include their gods.
God says these nations must not remain in Israel's land. What reason does He give?

answers.text: They would cause Israel to sin against Him
They would take the best fields for themselves
They would grow and outnumber the Israelites

cards.text: And God ends with this: "For if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you." It's like opening one group chat "real quick" and looking up an hour later.
